tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// mahārādzabaishrabaṇak+ṣemakaras+yakalpaswar+ṇabhādz+wālanāmadhāraṇiyas+sādhanaṃbiharatisma//

༄༅// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras bde byed kyi rtog pa gser 'od 'bar ba'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza bai shra shra ma ṇa baṇa sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi mtshan rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gtso bo 'dod pa'i lha dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha la dgos pa'i nor gyi dbang phyug dung dang dung chen la sogs rin chen gter la dbang zhing mnga' ba de la/ / 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa kun gyi nor 'chang klu kun gyi bdag po rje de gang yin na/ rgyal po de'i gnas byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po rnam thos sras// dngos grub longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa thun mong dang mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ ci byed ce na/ /dpal zhes tshogs gnyis dang ldan sems can thams cad dbul ba las ngal bsos sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' dge ba nor thams cad ster ba'i stobs po che// gsus pa che bas sbom zhing gang gis kyang zil gyis mi non cing gzhan dag 'joms pa seng ge dang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs// phyag gnyis kyi g.yon na kha nas rin po che skyugs pa'i rin chen ne'u le g.yas na be con bsnams pa'i rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /cho gas de sgrub rim pa bshad par bya// ga pur la sogs pa'i dri lnga lci ba la sogs pa rnam lnga yis// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod hūm̐ kham̐ ṇi lam̐ mam̐ yi ge bcu pa sa gzhi legs par byugs pa la de'i steng du phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi dbus rnams su lha grangs kyi tshom bu dgu ni me tog dkar po dgod/ /khyad par gyi dam tshig bzhi ste dam tshig bdun dang ldan pa yi// rgyal po'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rten gsum mda' me long phyi rten rta sngon po la sogs pa nang rten bse'i nang

du rgyal po'i sku gzugs dang nor bu rin po che rnyed tshang dang 'bru sna rnams za 'og la sogs par blugs la spa'o/ gzugs par bya// bdag nyid cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /oṃ a mṛ ta la sogs pa sngags rgyal bcu gsum rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis bzlas pa yis/ /bdag nyid kyi phyogs mtshams kun nas bsangs gtor bya// snying gar sa bon bsams pa las/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la yang yi ge rim pa bzhin du yod pa la rang gi yi ge'i 'od zer de rnams la rim bzhin du phog pas sngags btab pa'i tshul des/ byang phyogs 'od zer de'i rtse mo la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po rab 'phros te// 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum gyi gtso// rgyal po rnam thos gtso 'khor spyan drangs te/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rang dam tshig pa'i mdun du me tog gi tshom bu'i steng du rim par bzhugs par bsam// de la gong gi a mṛ ta'i sngags chus bsangs gtor nas brtsams te// rgyal po 'khor bcas snying ga'i lha mos mchod pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ bgegs bskrad bsangs gtor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ de la mchod pa badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa lnga dbul ba'i yi ge ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yi ge gsum dang ldan pa yis/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa so sor legs par sbyangs te dbul/ bdag phyag rdor gyi spyi gtsug lkog ma snying ga yi/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge las 'od 'phros pas rgyal po la phog ste zhu bas stong par bsam mo// don la ye shes pa mchog yin no/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyi 'od zer gyis/ mdun gyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ la phog pas rgyal po 'khor bcas de yid kyis sa bon 'od du zhu nas gnyis su med par bsam/ 'od zhu stong pa'i rang bzhin bya// de nas rang gi mdun du stong pa'i ngang las

bh+rūm̐ ser po gyur pa las ni/ /rgyu rin po chen che las grub pa'i zur re re la khang mig bcu gsum/ de yang sta'i zur la khang bu bcu gnyis khang bu brtsegs pa re bsgom// zur bzhi rim gsum du yod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus su/ lte ba dbus ma'i pho brang steng du gtso bo gnas sum brtsegs te/ de'i rtse mo rin chen bai ḍūr+ya nor bu gañdzi ras brgyan/ /khang pa'i logs la drwa ba drwa ba phyed pa rtse mo yang zer bkod/ mu khyud can/ gzhal yas khang de la shar sogs rgyu shel dkar po dang lho bai ḍār+ya gtso bo gnas/ nub pad+ma rā ga dmar po/ byang ser po gser gyi ni/ gser gyi ka ba stong phrag bcu ste khri phrag gcig yis brgyan/ /khang mig rnam pa bco lnga sgo bzhi mu khyud rta babs can gyis spras pa po// de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhi rnams su// bum pa bzang po brgyad dpag bsam shing brgyad// rin chen brgyad/ rdzing bu brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i rin chen mang gi sgrub thabs nas me tog rwa ba yod par bshad/ ba brgyad/ brgyad brgyad lnga yis bkra shis kyi rdzing bu rab tu mdzes/ /khang pa'i phyi rol na rin chen 'bar bas lcags ri'i tshul du rab tu bskor/ /khang pa'i dbus su seng ge'i steng du pad+ma de'i steng du zla ba de'i steng du sa bon bai3 yig las// 'od zer kha dgo sna tshogs yar mar du rab spros nas/ /sems can thams cad la phog pas ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyangs rin chen gyi char phab lha mi'i dbul ba bsal nas sems can gyi don byas slar bsdus bai la thim// de las rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas rdzogs par bsgom pa ni/ rin chen pho brang dam pa nas/ /rgyal po'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan de'i steng na pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sa bon/ /bai gyur pa las byung ba'i mgon po rnam thos sras ni/ /yang na sems can gyi don la ngal bsos dge ba

dbul po la nor ster ba la sogs pa'i stobs nus stobs po che/ /phyag g.yas na rin po che'i be con rgyal mtshan 'dzin// phyag g.yon na rin po che'i gter gyi ne'u le'i kha nas rin po che skyugs pa 'dzin// sku mdog ni gser btso ma rang gi gyi 'od pas yon tan rgyas pas mdzes// zhal nas rin po chen sna tshogs kyi char pa 'bebs/ /lha dang mi thugs rjes phongs pa 'i duḥkhas nyon mongs pa'i dbul ba las sgrol mdzad// sku la dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rin chen rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras/ /snang ba dbang du sdud pas phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi ma dang zla bas mtshan te brgyan pa/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od kyi mdangs can// dbu la cod pan rin chen rgyan gyis spras// gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor rang bzhin gyi 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad dang klu brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam/ rnams ni/ /de nas phyogs thams cad du nam mkha'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa bzhin du bsam/ 'khor rnams kyang nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' yang na nam mkha' la bang mdzod bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes pas/ seng ge'i steng na 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pas sems dpa'i phyed skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ de nas phyag rdor gyi hūm̐ dang dam tshig pa'i bai3 gnyis las 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi rgyal po rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs te/ /rdo rje dril stabs dang bcas pas rol mo bsgrags/ hūm̐/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam tshig las mi 'da' ba can/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus su// thams cad nyon mongs 'dam byings ba dang 'dra bar/ /sems can thams cad mtshams med lnga po kun spyod cing*/ /khyed kyi gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas/ sems can bdag ngan yang*/ /sngon shākya seng ge bha ga wā na'i spyan sngar khyod/ /sems can gyi don byed par thugs dam gang bzhes de yin pas khas blangs pa de dgongs la// 'dren pa

shākya seng ge'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /dgos pa sems can phongs pa rnams la sman slad du/ /so so'i phyogs kyi byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgongs pa sems can don phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ spyan 'dren pa'i sngags zla/ bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas gnas pa'i// hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis// rang bzhin rgyal po rnam thos sras/ 'khor gnod sbyin 'bum dang bcas bkug nas ni// nor bu las byas pa'i grong khyer de dbus su/ /rang gi mdun nas rgyal po de dbus dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis bsre bas bzhugs// rin po chen phyag rgyas dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsā mis byin brlabs nas// de nas yi ge bcu gsum pa'i sngags kyis bsang gtor nas brtsams mchod pa dbul te// rin po chen sna bdun dang bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi lha mos mchod pa la 'di med du mi rung*/ /gu gul dkar po bstod pa dbul zhing bstod/ gtso 'khor la bstod pa bya/ /de nas rang gi'am mdun gyi rgyal po'i thugs ka'i a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba la// sa bon bai3 ser po las sam hūm̐ las sngags kyi 'og gi bcu pas yongs bskor te/ /mdun gyi rgyal po dang rang gnyis ka'i byed pa'i tshe rang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer la mchod pa sna tshogs spros pas mchod/ lce la rdo rje'i sbu gu bsam// sngags kyi bzlas pa'i spro bsdu ni rgyal po'i dngos grub tshur bsdu// bdag nyid dang mdun gyi rgyal po gtso 'khor thams cad kyi so so'i thugs kar dmigs la bzlas/ tad+ya thā/ gnod sbyin thams cad la 'bod pa'i sngags/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/

su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha me sā dha ya/ tad+yā tha su ra me/ su ra se/ su ma ti/ hi li mi li swā hā/ gcun pa'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bai3 shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ tshad phan yon/ 'di brjod bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu// zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga la// tsan+dan dkar po dang ba'i rnam lnga byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor bya/ maṇ+ḍal byas pa'i dri'i thig le'i dbus/ de nas rgyal po rnam thos sras la dmigs la/ /a ka ru'i spos bsreg sngags te sngar gyi bzlas pa bya/ 'di ni bzlas pa'i grangs thun re re la sngags ring tad+ya thā sogs brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /dus nyin mo thun gsum dang mtshan mo thun gsum ste lan drug tu/ mdun gyi rgyal po la dmigs bai3 sngags bzlas nas phrin las bcol na/ /bdag nyid kyi rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar byed// dpag tshad brgya ni tshun chad du// rgyal po 'khor gnod sbyin rnams kyis ni rang la srung bar byed/ rang gi bsam pa ci 'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid cing*/ log 'tsho rku 'phrog gsum kha na ma tho med pa yi chos dang mthun pa'i/ /zas dang skom thams cad dang bcas pa yi/ /gter nor dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser la sogs pa stsol bar bgyid/ rin po che yi gter la sogs pa mang po/ bsod nams lnga tshad med 'grub par 'gyur// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub// de la sogs pa 'i bsam pa thams cad ma lus pa'i 'bras bu 'grub/ bsgom pa dang bzlas pas ngal bar gyur na gshegs su gsol/ gtso 'khor kun la de'i sngags kyis mchod bstod gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas bzod par gsol ba dang*/ dkar gtor btang la rang nyid 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ gtor ma ji ltar btang zhe na/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ dang swa bhā wa sa bsang gtor ma dang snod gnyis stong par bsams la

bh+rūm̐ las gtor ma'i snod bskyed la/ rdzas kyi dngos po de kham̐ dkar po las gzhal yas khang nam mkha' dang mnyam par ro brgya dang ldan par bskyed par bya/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam ste lag pa gnyis ut+pal lta bu'i phyag rgya byas la ngag tu/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ lag pa gnyis thal mo snying gar sbyar la sangs rgyas spyan nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags gyis gtor ma de dpag tu med pa spel byas la/ sngags rgyal bcu gsum bzlas par bya// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha ye swā hā/ so so'i sngags la sngar gyi gtor ma'i sngags btags te dbul/ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// bdag gis gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol nas kyang*/ bdag cag sgrub pa po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bu sdug bzhin du skyong bar mdzod// bdag la gnod par byed par sems pa yi// log par zhugs pa'i sems can gdon dang bgegs kun/ de yi cho 'phrul dpung rnams gzhom pa dang*// gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// de nas rgyal pos khas blangs par bsams la gshegs su gsol/ bai thung sum cu so gnyis la bai ring gcig gi tshad du dbug gcig gis bai yig sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dren/ snying ga'i lcags kyu bkrol la ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can phongs pa rnams kyi don kun mdzad/ rjes su mthun pa'i longs spyod la sogs pa dngos grub stsol/ byang phyogs gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// bdag gis phyis spyan 'dren pa'i dus su slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la gshegs su gsol/ /mdun gyi dam tshig sems dpa' 'od zhu bsam// rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan

dam tshig sems dpar bskyed par byas pa la// rang bzhin rgyal po ye shes sems dpa' bkug la bstim/ /mdun gyi rgyal po de rang phyag na rdo rjer bsgoms pa'i zhabs kyis mnan la dbang du bsdu// oṃ bai3 shra ma ṇa ye a nu rā dza ku ru swā hā/ de ltar cho ga thams cad sbyor dngos rjes gsum rdzogs par byas gyur na/ /gtso bo rgyal po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis// sgrub pa po'i yid la gang 'dod pa thams cad skong bar byed// longs spyod zad pa med pa nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes rang ci 'dod 'byung 'gyur/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i rnam thos sras bde byed kyi rtogs pa mang du yod pa las khyad par du bsdus pa che chung gnyis las che ba rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de wa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/

/'di maṇ+ḍal tshom bu la brten pa kho na'o/ /dge'o// 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ ne'u le srid pa'i mthongs na gnas pa gcig gis rnam thos sras la nor brkur phyin pas zin nas phyag na bsnams pas srid pa'i rtse mo yang zil gyis non pa'i rtags/ de ltar lha sras rnams kyis kyang de ltar bzung ngo*// ༈ /rin chen khang brtsegs bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza gu h+ya sid+dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// chos skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras// yon tan thams cad 'byung ba yi// gnod sbyin de yi sgrub thabs bshad// drag byed dang ni bde byed las// 'dir ni bde byed gtso bor ston// drag byed zhar la 'byung ba'o// gsung gi sgrub pa rgyal po chen po bzhis bskor ba la brten nas gnod sbyin longs spyod du bsgrub pa/ phrin las bdud mo bzhis bskor ba la brten nas gnod sbyin mthu ru bsgrub pa'o// de la phyi rgyal po chen po bzhi bskor du bsgrub pa la/ dben pa'i gnas su rgyal po chen po'i rten ni/ pho brang sum brtsegs lcog bzhir ldan// rin chen 'bar ba'i lcog gis mdzes// kha bad dang bcas shis pa'i sa la brtsigs// pho brang de yi lte ba ru// mtshan ldan gri thod gri snying gsum// rten 'khor ga bur dri lnga dang*// sman lnga 'bru lnga rat+na lnga// shis pa'i gos dril gzungs thag gdags// pho brang de yi dkyil du gzhug /gzungs thag pho brang 'og la 'dogs// pho brang de yi rtse na yar// smyug rgod lo 'dab rgyas pa dang*// dar sna khrab byang gser dang g.yu// mu tig mu men byi ru dngul// stag dang gzig gi ras ma dang*// snying sna dang bcas btags la gzugs// de yi mdun du 'dzin gtor bca'// dri dang spos kyis chag chag gdab// mchod pa rnam pa lnga yang bsham// de nas rang nyid stong par sbyangs// de yi ngang las yi ge hūm̐// 'phros 'dus phyag na rdo rjer bsgom// mdun du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang*// rin chen pho brang dam par bskyed// de dkyil hrīḥlas pad+ma'i steng*// sam̐ las seng ge bai las rgyal po bskyed// sku mdog ser po gzi brjid 'bar// phyag g.yas rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin// g.yon pa ne'u le'i rkyal pa dku la brten// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin gyis// rin chen char pa 'bebs par byed// gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// nam mkha'i sprin bzhin 'thibs par bsam// rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las// rgyal po spyan drangs de la bstim// sku gsung thugs kyang byin gyis brlabs// mchod pa'i tshogs spros de la mchod// rgyal po'i thugs las dngos grub ni// sna tshogs rang gi thugs kar bsdu// gsang sngags 'di la 'bum phrag bcu// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra be ru rā ga swā hā/ de yi rtags la rab 'bring gsum// rab ni dngos su mthong ba la// 'bring ni nyams dga' 'khor la 'bab// tha ma rmi lam rta pa zhub can dang*// btsad po bud med tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// de nas dbang sdud las sngags gdags// bha bha ra/ bha bha sa/ rā dza ṇi tri myos myos/ shra ma ṇa ye wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ni sgrub pa'i rim pa ste// bsnyen pa dang bcas zhag bdun sbrel// de nas las la sbyar ba ni// bum pa 'khor lo sbyin sreg go /bum pa las la sbyar ba ni// dri med rat+na'i bum pa ru// srog chags med pa'i chu blugs la// dkar gsum mngar gsum dri yis brgyan// rin chen gzungs sngags dam pa 'di// 'bras la sngags te bum par blug /oṃ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ sa sta ya sa sta ya/ ghu na ghu na/ rat+na sid+dhi ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bum pa rgyal po dngos su bsam// de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis// rgyal po'i sprul pas stong gsum gang*// bsdus te bang mdzod khengs par bsam// bum pa'i las sbyor zhag bdun bya// chu des lus bkrus khong du btang*// gzi brjid tshad med skye bar 'gyur// gsod par 'dod pa'i dgra bos kyang*// bu sdug bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur// kun gyi yid 'phrog nor rnams 'du// 'khor lo las la sbyar ba ni// 'khor lo dpe'u chung bzhin du bri// gang 'dod snying gi dkyil du bskor// zhag bdun dag gis lha mo yang*// mdun du khug par the tshom med// oṃ bai dzaṃ/ sur ma ku sang ghu san ti/ che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ tshwa yi thun gyis brdeg par bya// gang 'dod dbang du 'du bar 'gyur// sbyin sreg las la sbyar ba ni// thab khung rin chen 'bar bas brgyan// 'o ma can gyi shing brtsegs la// 'bru sman rin chen dar gos ras// dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' dang bcas// mchod pa lnga ni yang dag bsham// thab tu rgyal po 'khor bcas bskyed// rang bzhin rgyal po bkug la bstim// de la dngos sam yid kyis mchod// thab tu me sbar bsreg rdzas 'bul// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/

be ru rā ga pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas 'bul/ dus bzhir sbyin sreg zhag bdun bya// 'dod pa thams cad char du 'bebs// rgyal po dngos su 'byon par 'gyur// mngag pa'i las rnams byed par 'gyur// bsnyen pa sgrub pa las sbyor gsum// de ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la// dngos grub ma lus rnam thos sras pos ster// rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi gsang sgrub rin chen khang brtsegs zhes bya ba rdzogs so// ༈ /rnam sras kyi srog 'khor dgos 'dod kun 'byung dang nor sgrub las tshogs bzhugs so// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi man ngag dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi dngos grub sgrub byed pa'i// de yi rim pa bstan par bya// de la rnam pa lnga ru bstan// dngos grub gzhi sgrub brten sgrub dang*// sham bu bdun gyi dngos grub sgrub// tshe sgrub bse rag kha 'ching ngo*// nor gyi gzhi sgrub 'di lta ste// rgyal po bsgrub pa'i sngon rol du// 'dus byed dge ba grub tshad bya// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam la// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// chos skyong rgyal po 'khor bcas la// gtor ma mchod pa tshul bzhin bya// rigs drug gtor ma rgyun du btang*// bya khyi dman pa'i sems can la// sbyin pa bag re man chad btang*// khab skud la sogs sbyin pa kun// sems can phongs la sbyin par bya// de ni dngos grub gzhi sgrub ste// rnam thos sgrub pa'i rim pa ni// rin chen khang brtsegs nang du bstan// de ltar bsgrubs pas gter rnams 'phel// gal te 'phel bar ma gyur na// nor gyi rten gzugs bstan par bya// rin chen ga'u yod na legs// med na rdza yi ga'u ru// steng na 'khor lo rtsibs klu bri// 'og tu pad+ma 'dab nor bri// nang du rin chen sna lnga dang*// 'bru sna lnga dang snying po lnga// g.yu dang dar zab zas bzang dang*// bsod nams can gyi dreg pa dang*// rten gyi 'khor lo gser bris dang*// rnam thos tsa ka li dang ni// phyug po'i khyim bdun bang mdzod dang*// bkra shis brgyad dang rin chen bdun// ga'u'i nang du blugs par bya// dar sna'i rgya chings legs byas la// bkra shis yar ngo'i tshes gsum la// nor lha'i sku la sngags zlos te// rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// spyan drangs mchod bstod de la bstim// mchod pa rgyas pa phul byas nas// ji srid bzhugs par gsol ba gdab// rgyab yol la sogs mal 'og tu// mis ma mthong bar sba bar bya// ci za ci 'thung phud kyis mchod// dus dus su mchod pa rgya cher dbul// de ni nor gyi rten gzugs so// phyug po g.yang can thod pa ru// kye ba la sogs sngo sna tshogs// phyug po g.yang can thod pa dang*// las sbyor tsakra de dag kun// thod par bcug la nor lha mchod// dus dus su mchod pa chen po dbul// thod pa rwa ba'i dkyil du sba// nor phyugs thams cad 'du 'phel lo// nor gta' gzugs pa med gyur na// zhabs med snod du bcud blugs 'dra// des na gta' dang rten gzugs gces// de ni nor rten gta' gzugs pa'o// nor sgrub rim pa bstan pa ni// sgrub pa las sbyor khang brtsegs dag tu blta// sems bskyed rim pa 'dis 'grub 'gyur// bdag gis gnod sbyin 'di bsgrubs la// bla ma dkon mchog mchod par bya// sems can phongs la zas gos nor// gang dang gang dgos sbyin par bya// snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya// rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer bsgom// mdun du rgyal po 'khor bcas bskyed// bsnyen sgrub las rnams rdzogs nas ni// mchod gtor rgya chen bshams byas la// mchod bstod ma lus tshang byas te// de nas dngos grub blang ba ni// bsnyen pa'i sngags la sham bu gdags// bsnyen pa 'di la 'bum phrag bcu// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye be ru rā ga swā hā/

zhes pa'i sham la dngos grub sngags// bsgyur nas bzlas pas las rnams 'grub// 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas sham bur ni// zas 'dod btags la bzlas pa ni// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye be ru rā ga na na kha dho sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes pa 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na// kha zas 'bad pa med par thob// sham bu 'di med bsnyen pas kyang*// zhing yod so nam mi byed 'dra// 'bum phrag lnga pa'i sham bur ni// nor 'dod sngags 'di gdags par bya// dha na me sid+dhi sarba pha la hūm̐ swā hā/ sham bu 'di med bsnyen pa ni// 'brog yod phyugs ma med pa 'dra// 'bum phrag drug pa'i sham bur ni// 'khor 'dod sngags 'di gdags par gsungs// ta la sa po sid+dhi sarba pha la hūm̐ swā hā/ sham bu 'di med bsnyen pas kyang*// thang stong tshong pa bskyal ba 'dra// rkun gyis chags par ga la 'gyur// 'bum phrag bdun pa'i sham bur ni// rigs 'phel bsod nams bskyed pa ni// hri ral puṇ+ya ma hā puṇ+ya rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā/ sham bu 'di med bsnyen pas kyang*// brag steng sa bon btab pa 'dra// lo thog skye bar ga la 'gyur// 'bum phrag brgyad kyi sham bur ni// tshe 'phel sngags 'di gdags par gsungs// ā yur+dzñā na yu tshe a pa ra sid+dhi sarba pha la hūm̐ swā hā/ sham bu 'di med bsnyen pas kyang*// bung bas sbrang rtsi bsags pa bzhin// bsags pa gzhan gyis spyod par 'gyur// 'bum phrag dgu pa'i sham bur ni// bcud len sngags 'di gdags par gsungs// rat+na rat+na/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ sarba dha dha ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas bcud len sman rnams thob// sham bu 'di med bsnyen pas kyang*// chu yod yur ba med pa 'dra// zhing la phan par mi 'gyur ro// 'bum phrag bcu pa'i sham bur ni// mngon shes sgrub pa'i sngags 'di btags// badz+ra kha da kha da ha da ni sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzlas srid gsum gsal bar mthong*// dngos grub bdun pa'i man ngag 'di// kun la bstan par ngas ma gsungs// bum pa 'khor lo sbyin sreg dang*// las sbyor gsum po byed pa na// gang 'dod sham bur rdzas rnams 'bul// zas 'dod kha zas bzang po 'bul// bcud len dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bul// mngon shes 'dod na me tog 'bul// de ltar rang rang rdzas phul bas// dngos grub gang 'dod thob par 'gyur// de nas sgrub pa 'di bstan te// gnod sbyin rgyal po'i tshe sgrub 'dis// tshe dpal thams cad rgyas par byed// de yi rim pa 'di lta ste// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi la// 'dab brgyad pad+ma mu khyud bcas// kha dog dkar po bri bar bya// de dbus rin chen bum pa ru// bdud rtsi lnga dang a mṛ ta// rin chen lnga dang snying po lnga// 'bru lnga mar gyi ril bu gzhug

/tshe 'bras dag gis kha bcad la// mgul chings ras la g.yu gdags bya// gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba bsham// gzhan yang gnod sbyin mchod pa'i rdzas// 'byor tshad bsham pa man ngag yin// bdag nyid badz+ra pā ṇir bsgom// bh+rūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang*// yangs shing mdzes pa bskyed par bya// a las nyi ma zla ba'i gdan// siṃ las seng ge'i gdan steng du// rgyal po bai las bskyed par bya// 'khor gyi gnod sbyin k+ṣa las bskyed// kun kyang sku mdog dkar po la// g.yas pa kun na lcags kyu thogs// g.yon pa shel gyi bum pa bsnams// kha rgyan gser gyi rdo rje la// nang na tshe yi bdud rtsis bkang*// kun gyis 'jig rten gang bar bsgom// spyan drangs bzhugs la gnyis med bstim// de nas bdag dang gnod sbyin gyi// thugs ka'i 'od 'phros lcags kyu yis// tshe 'phrog bum par bstim par bya// sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas// oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi yu ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas tshe bum gang bar bsam// sngags 'di bdag gi thugs kar bstim// oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi yuḥ.ā yuḥṣe hūm̐/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya hūm̐/ de nas tshe sgrub bstan pa ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye/ be ru rā ga ā yuḥtshe yur+dzñā na bin+dhu a pa ri mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐/ zhes bzla/ sngar bskyed gnod sbyin sprul pa dang*// bcas pas 'jig rten thams cad gang*// bcud kyi sems can tshe dpal rnams// g.yas kyi lcags kyus bkug nas ni// g.yon gyi bum par bsdus byas nas// tshe yi rten la thim par bsam// de ltar tshe ni bsgrubs pa yis// rtags ni tshe chang khol ba sogs// de ltar rtags bzang byung ba dang*// tshe bum rang gi spyi bor bzhag /dmigs pa 'di ltar bsam par bya// phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yi// sku gsung thugs la ye shes bcug /tshe yi bdud rtsi bsdus byas te// bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang*// bdag gi tshangs pa'i bu gar thim// thugs nyi zla kha sbyor nang du thim// de las ṇi la thim par bsam// hrīḥdang yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐// de yi nang na yi ge hūm̐// cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa// bde gshegs thugs dang mnyam par gyur// sngags 'di rang la thim par bsam// oṃ bh+rūm̐ ā bh+rūm̐ yu bh+rūm̐ ṇi bh+rūm̐/

tshe chang btung zhing zas la rol// tshe ni lo stong gnas par 'gyur// tshe sgrub med pas rnam thos sgrub// gnod sbyin ma rungs pa rnams kyis// tshe las phri nas bsod nams bskyed// tshe la bar chad 'byung srid pas// tshe sgrub byed pa shin tu gces// 'gro bzang snying po'i tshe sgrub 'dis// bar chad byung ba gcig kyang med// tshe yang tshangs pa dag dang mnyam// bse rag kha chings 'di ltar bcing*// dang po rmi lam 'di ltar 'ong*// rang gis thob pa'i zas nor dag /gzhan ma dag gis khyer ba dang*// snod stong mtha' ma bskor ba dang*// sprang po ngan long yid mi 'ong*// kun gyi gseb na 'dug pa rmi// de ltar byung na kha chings bya// dang po gtor ma chu gtor sbyin// bden pa rgya cher bdar bar bya// de nas sa sbyin dag la ni// mchod rten dkar po khru gang bya// bum par brten 'brel snying po bzhag /phyag rdor rgyal chen bzhi yi sngags// legs par bris pa bum par gzhug /mchod rten gdan khri'i 'og tu ni// bse rag 'gong po'i lto ba ru// tsakra rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bcas// rtsibs la sngags 'di dgod par bya// rā dza/ tre'u/ ha sha /dzaḥtri/ rbad/ chings/ nan/ mchan la/ 'gong po yam sho nan/ 'gong po tri sho nan/ 'gong po tri'u nan/ rā dza kha thaṃ/ rā dza tri kha thaṃ/ god srid kha thaṃ/ sris rkun kha thaṃ/ phag shu mu tra kha thaṃ/ lte bar/ tri'u ya sho tri sho gang gnod ming bri/ mu khyud la/ ya tri kha thaṃ/ ma tri kha thaṃ/ a tri kha thaṃ/ su tri kha thaṃ/ ra tri kha thaṃ/ kan+ni kha thaṃ/ du tri kha thaṃ/ tsa tri kha thaṃ/ sngon dmar skud pas rgya gram bcings// la chas btums la gdan khrir gzhug /drag po'i sngags 'dis skabs su gzir// oṃ ni lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza ku be ra/ be ru rā ga sid+dhi sa ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ pre tre ta ra tsi ye swā hā/ oṃ be ta ka ya swā hā/

oṃ be du tri ya swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ rā dza yak+ṣa tre'u sgu nan/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di skabs su bzlas// mchod rten mal gyi rtsig logs sba// skabs su mchod dang bskor ba bya// dus su sngags kyang drag tu bzlas// mis ma mthong bar bya ba'o// de ni kha chings dang po'o// gnyis pa byang bu sor bzhi la// sngags 'di tshar gsum bris nas kyang*// sgo yi ya them dag la gdags// oṃ me ta ra hūm̐ druṃ phroṃ phroṃ ki li bh+yo rbad/ bdag gi god kha bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol swā hā/ gsum pa shog bu dag la ni// sngags 'di bris la brgya rtsa bzlas// phur pa dag la gdab par bya// phur pa sris nang bcug gyur na// zas kyi bse rag 'ching bar 'gyur// oṃ ru lu mu lu tsa na ti swā hā/ zhes pa bri dang bzlas pa'o// zhes pa'i man ngag dam pa 'di// 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa yin// / badz+ra pā ṇi la na mo/ rnam thos sras kyi bsad gso gnyis las/ gnad kyi man ngag gab pa shin tu zab pa/ ma grub pa

las byed du ma btub na gnad la dbab pa la/ rdzas la gu gul mu zi khyi lud gsum/ rgyal po'i sku dang*/ seng ge rin po che la bya/ nang khong stong du bya/ gser/ dngul/ lcags/ dar sna lnga thod pa'i phyi tshas so// sku de yugs sa mo'i 'doms yang na dor rtas dril/ su bcug la rang gi mal 'og tu sba/ badz+ra pā ṇir bsgom/ badz+ra pā ṇi'i sngags la bai shra ma ṇa bzlog la bzla'o rang nyid de'i khar bsdad la/ nyin zhag gnyis bya'o// de la ma byung na gong rdzas khyi lud dud pas bdug go /gsum la sku mgo mjug ldog la sngags bzlog yungs kar dang bsres la brab/ la bzlas/ yi dam gsal du bsgom sngags la btags la brabs// yungs kar mtshon du byin gyis brlabs/ gu gul gyi chu byugs/ /des mi 'ong mi 'grub mi srid do// bsad pa'i man ngag go gso bas/ /gso ba la/ tsan+dan/ ga bur dzā ti/ a ka ru/ de rnams kyi chus sku khrus gsol/ rnam 'joms 'don cing rab gnas bskyar/ sngags bzla'o// dar sna lngas g.yogs/ rang badz+ra pā ṇi gzhan bai shra ba ṇa gsal ba gal che/ gtor chen dang seng ge'i gtor ma bshams la rang phyag rdor du bsgom/ sngags ring la bai shra ma ṇa btags la bzla'o// rtags bzang po byung ba dang gsol ba gdab/ mchod pa bya/ dngos grub blang*/ rten dang sre mong thod pa gnyis sba'o// lam du zhugs na mchan khung g.yon du bcang*/ dngos grub ci 'dod ster ro/ /'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ rdzogs so// bsnyen pas nyer ma btub na/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye snying khrag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tsit+ta sa ma ya dam dam/ dzaḥdzaḥ bsgrub pa la rtags med na/ ye ṇa ma shra bai sma ra sma ra/ sha ri ti sa pa ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ des kyang ma grub na/ kho'i thang sku las/ sku 'bag 'brub khung nang du gzhug khrag sna dug sna byugs/ gri bo'i lag pa g.yas pas brab/ rang yi dam du bsgom/ bkrag dang gzi mdangs 'phrog par bsam/

bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsol cig ces zer zhing*/ zas dang longs spyod nor gyi char 'bebs par bsam/ slar phyung la mchod gtor gyis mnyes par byas/ bzod par gsol/ oṃ ni lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi bai shra ma ṇa ye hūm̐/ sid+dhi 'dus 'dus/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ gcun sngags lags so// rgya'i lpags pa mkhyid gang pa gcig la gser gyi byi ba kha sprod gnyis bri/ kha nas rin po che skyugs pa/ byi ba'i 'og na phar sngags 'di bri'o// oṃ ya du sa du s+t+waṃ/ dam tshig tu mi la mi bstan/ rab nor/ 'bring phyugs/ tha ma zas dang longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur ro// nor sgrub la 'di las zab pa med do// rgya ru la pad+ma'i steng du gser gyi byi ba kha sprod bris la/ rin chen skyugs pa bya/ rgya ru'i kha na phar sngags 'di/ oṃ ya du sa du s+t+waṃ/ zhes bri/ de rang gi bang mdzod du sba/ mi la mi bstan/ gsang ba rgya ru la brten nas nor bsgrub pa'o// yang lcags mkhyid gang la byi ba kha sprod gzong gis bris la/ kha nas rin po che skyugs pa bya/ rin po che za ba dang skyugs pa na ra ra/ 'og na phar sngags 'di bri/ oṃ ya du sa du s+t+waṃ/ 'og na pad+ma'i gdan yod pa/ dam tshig mis mi mthong ba'o// nor sgrub gcig la 'di la zab pa med gsungs/ nor rdzas mngon par sgrub pa la/ gyim shom 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ 'grub pa/ rdzas pha wang mgo gser dngul/ g.yu chung bcang ngo*// rin chen lnga brdar la bya/ phye mar/ shug pa dang spos sbyar la bsreg grub rtags grogs dang mgron po mang po rmi/ khar rje dang zas 'du'o// sho thob/ rgyan thams cad las rgyal lo// oṃ be sho mu kha sho dzaḥmang mang 'du/ ā be sha dzaḥ zhag gsum mam lnga bsgrub/ gnas gtsang mar bsgrub par bya/ rnam 'joms khrus dang gtsang sbra cher bya/ ci za ba'i zas kyis mchod/ rab tu gsang la bsgrub/ zlum po me tog tshom bu lnga bkod/

maṇ+ḍal gyi pū dza lnga dang*/ gtor ma dkar gsum gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal/ gser dngul zangs dung phor ram/ bum par bsgrub bo// oṃ bai gcig po la nyi ma phyed bzlas/ de nas dril la bzlas/ sho mang po sbyin par btang ngo*// shin tu zab gsungs so// / yang mi byi ba lo pa gcig gis 'bru sna rnyed tshad slong du bcug la/ 'bru lnga/ snying po lnga/ de rnams rgya rur bcug rgya ru'i kha la/ sa du ya du s+t+waṃ/ ngos la gser gyis byi ba kha sprod bri/ de'i phan yon ni/ nas/ mar/ sha nor rdzas/ tshwa gang yin gyi gseb tu bcug pas/ de 'du'o// shin tu zab gsungs so// yang zangs mkhyid pa gang pa gas chag med pa gcig la/ byi ba kha sprod gnyis bris la/ rin chen skyugs pa bya/ pad gdan yod pa la sngags 'di 'og na phar bri/ oṃ ya du sa du staṃ/ rab gnas byas la mis ma mthong bar bya'o// nor sgrub gcig la 'di las zab pa med gsungs so// / nor sgrub 'di ni rten 'brel rdzas kyi 'du ba yin te/ rab rin po che gser gyis byi ba kha sprod/ 'bring rkun chen gyi lag pa/ tha ma sha pho rwa bcu'o// de la rab kyis rgya ru la gser gyis byi ba kha sprod 'bur la dod pa mu tig skyugs pa byas la/ rab gnas dang*/ gsol mchod bya/ ci za ci 'thung gi kha nas phud bcad la/ rin po che gser gyi byi ba kha sprod/ bdag la zas nor gyi dngos grub stsol cig ces byas la byi ba'i phyogs la gtor/ 'bring rkun chen gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du gser gyis yi ge hūm̐ gcig bris la/ bang mdzod kyi ka ba la btsugs la/ bdag la zas nor gyi dngos grub stsol cig byas la/ phud de'i phyogs la gtor/ tha ma sha pho rwa bcu'i rkang la gser gyis rten 'brel snying po bris la bang mdzod kyi nang du bcug nas/ de la gsol mchod byas na nor 'du/ sha pho rwa bcu bdag la zas nor gyi dngos grub stsol cig byas la/

zas phud kyis mchod/ zas gang za yang dran par bya/ le lo byas na mi 'grub/ de ltar byas na lo gsum bzhi na nor spungs pa bzhin 'byung*/ shin tu zab/ yang rgya ru ma nyams pa gcig legs par bzhogs la/ phyed yan sngon por bya/ man chad tshon rtsis dmar por bya/ bar du rin po che za ra tshags gser ram mtshal gyis bri/ stod du byi ba'i gzugs rin po che la bya/ kha nas nor bu skyugs pa gser gyis gnyis bya/ de gnyis kyi rtsar/ gser ram/ rin po ches/ oṃ sa ha rat+na hūm̐/ zhes bri/ kha skor la/ sa ha ya du s+t+waṃ/ ces shong tshad bri/ de'i nang du g.yu chung mig ma phug pa cig 'bru sna tshogs/ rin po che tshogs tshang rnams rgya rur blugs la/ skar ma rgyal gyi dus su kha shar du bltas la/ rdzas kyis mchod/ lag g.yon gyi rdzas rnams rgya rur blugs pa rang yin gsungs/ mchan khung du bcug la/ rang ci za'i phud kyis lag pa g.yas kyis g.yon gyi phyogs la gtor/ 'thor ba'i dus su byi ba'i kha nas mu tig phra mo skyugs par bsam/ rdzas dang longs spyod gang 'dod 'byung gsungs so// / yang mi rkun ma grags pa gcig gi lag pa rnyed na mchog tu dga'/ ma rnyed na gang rung gcig la lag mthil la dang po'i sngags bkod/ de nas ming bris la/ zas nor spungs shig ces gsol ba gdab/ mkhrig ma la sngags 'og ma dang*/ hūm̐ bri/ de nas rgya ru dang lag pa sbrel la dar zab kyis dril/ rang gar 'gro yang rgya ru mchan khung du bcangs/ lag pa mi 'khyar bar gces mdzod du gzhug dam tshig tu byi ba la mi brdeg mi gtsang*/ rgya ru'i nang du rin po che dang*/ sman dang*/ dar zab sna tshogs kyis dgang*/ gsham zangs kyis bsdam/ rten 'brel gyis zas nor dang dngos grub thob pas/ byi ba lag pa gnyis 'dzom na dngos grub myur/ ma 'dzom na bul/ slob dpon phul+la ha ri'i lugs so// / rgya'i lpags pa la byi ba kha sbyor bri la/ rab gnas bya/ rin po che mchan khung g.yon du'o// rang zas za ba'i dus su changs bu lnga'am bdun 'bul/

sngags ni/ oṃ i ling ki si ling ki ki ling ki swā hā/ oṃ na ma shu karmu khri ma hā pi shā tsi na ye swā hā/ oṃ a na le kuṇ+ḍa lī karna ba a bhi ṣiñtsa ye swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// phyi gri rgod kyi lag pa la brten te bsgrub pa/ nang gser gyi byi ba kha sprod la brten pa/ gsang ba rgya ru la brten pa/ yang gsang bse'i gwa'u la brten te bsgrub pa'o// phyi ltar sgrub pa'i srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ be ru rā ga pra mi si ti me pra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nang ltar sgrub pa'i srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra nā ga rā dza swā hā/ gsang ba ltar srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ be sha ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ yang gsang ltar sgrub pa'i srog gi snying po ni/ rā dza ku be ra be ru rā dza pra mi sid+dhi me pra ya rā dza a pa rā dzi ta yak+ṣa shu me swā hā/ bsgrubs nas gal te dngos grub ster ma nyan na/ dngos grub kyi sngags 'di sham bur gdags/ mu kha yam/ a pa yam/ ka pa yam/ yam yam swā hā/ des gang 'dod gyi dngos grub ster ro// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sham bu'o// 'di gsang ngo*// sku 'khar ba la brten te bsgrub pa/ gsung gtor ma la brten te bsgrub pa/ thugs tsit+ta la brten te bsgrub pa/ yon tan rin po che la brten te bsgrub pa/ phrin las phur pa la brten te bsgrub pa'o// sku mi 'gyur ba srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra nā ga rā dza swā hā/ gsung mi 'gyur ba srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ be shra be ra ye swā hā/ thugs mi 'gyur ba srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa swā hā/ yon tan mi 'gyur ba srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra rā dza sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ phrin las mi 'gyur ba srog gi snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rnam sras sre thod ma la/ maṇ+ḍal/ dam rdzas/ bskyed rim rnams gzhan dang mthun/

bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye hūm̐/ rtags kyang mthun/ de nas sgrub sngags ni/ nā ga rat+na tsakra gu h+ya sid+dhi ā yu sa la hūm̐/ zhes gong ma la btags la zhag gsum bsgrub/ rtags byung na dngos grub blang ba ni mthun/ bsnyen pas ster ma btub na/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye snying khrag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya daṃ daṃ dza dzaḥ sgrub pa la rtags med na/ ye ṇa ma shra bai oṃ/ sma ra sma ra/ rat+na sma sma sha ri ti saṃ ba te puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ des kyang ma grub na/ kho'i sku'am/ thang sku 'grub khung du gzhug khrag sna dug sna byugs/ gri bo'i lag pa g.yas pas brabs/ rang yi dam du bsgom/ bkrag dang gzi mdangs 'phrogs par bsam/ bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsol cig zer zhing zas nor gyi char 'bebs par bsam/ slar phyung la mchod gtor gyis mnyes par bya'o// bzod gsol byed/ sngags la 'dra min 'dug pas bris pa lags so// ri dwags rgya'i lpags pa la/ byi ba kha sprod ser po che ba bris la/ de yang nor bu gcig gi kha nas skyugs/ gcig gis len pa 'brel ma chad par bri'o// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs can gyi dgug gzhug bya/ de rab gnas yin/ de yul du sdod na bang mdzod du sba'o// byes su 'gro na sgro bar gzhug kha sub la shing gi bar du bcug ci za ci 'thung gi phud dang*/ longs spyod gang yin gyi phud der bskyal la/ byi ba'am rkun ma'i ming nas bos la/ 'jig rten gyi nor rdzas khyod kyis 'dir khug cig ces brjod par bya'o// mis ma mthong bar bya/ nor sgrub 'di'i man ngag ni/ mi rkun ma byi ba 'dra ba'i lag pa g.yas pa rdza phor du bcug la/ de bang mdzod du bcug ste/ bza' btung gi phud der bskyal zhing*/ lag pa de/ mi shi ba'i ming shes na de nas 'bod/ mi shes na khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nor rdzas thams cad 'dir bsdus shig ces brjod cing lag pa g.yab/

yang lag pa kha sbub la bzhag gang dang sdeb kyang rab/ gang rung gis phun sum tshogs par the tshom med gsungs/ nor sgrub 'di la gnyis spel ba dang dgug pa'o// spel ba ni/ rgya lcags la byi ba gnyis kyi gzugs bris la/ gcig gis nor bu skyugs/ gcig gis bzed pa'i tshul du byas la/ 'jam dpal tshar gsum mam ci rigs pa bton la rab gnas bya/ de dar tshon sna lngas dril/ mdzod du sba/ mis ma mthong bar bya/ rten 'brel snying pos mtha' 'khor bar bya/ rab gnas bya/ gtor ma btang ngo*// / gnyis pa gzhan gyi nor dgug pa ni/ mi rkun ma byi ba 'dra ba gcig gi lag pa'i sor mo la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mthil du hrīḥbris la/ mi phyug po gsum las lcags dum re blangs la/ de la byang bu bya/ de la gzong gis byi ba rgyab sprod bri/ rin po ches bris kyang rung*/ de lag mthil du bcug la/ dus gnyan la bza' btung bzang pos gsol mchod bya/ nor khug cig byas la/ rang dang mi 'bral bar gang 'gror khyer ro// sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la rag ma lus pa rgya stag byi la ma bya ba/ lha sa'i gter ma'o// / 'di'i rab gnas gong mas bya/ shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ// ༈ /rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos sras kyi mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba bzhugs so// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// gdong bzhi mig stong nyin mtshan byed par rab brdzis shing*// gdug pa'i lag 'gro nor bu'i rgyan can rgyan du byas// hūm̐ hūm̐ nga ros dregs ldan 'byung po'i snying 'byin pa// drag po gsum 'dul khro rgyal zhabs ni spyi bor zhog /'khor ba'i g.yul bzlog rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// phongs pa'i nad sel gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin// gdong lnga'i steng na nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// rab brjid gnas srung dbul ba'i gdung skyob rgyal// chos skyong chen po sgrub pa'i thabs// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang*// rgyud las byung ba ji bzhin du// dam pas bskul phyir bri bar bya// 'dir slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos rang gzhan gyi don la mngon par brtson pas rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad pas/

dpal phyag na rdo rje'i zhal gzigs shing*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa des/ phyi rabs kyi skye bos bdag gdug pa'i gdon gyis zin pa dang thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams la phan gdags pa dang*/ gdul bya rnams kyi dbul ba bsal ba dang*/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra bo tshar gcod pa'i phyir rgyud rdo rje sa 'og dang*/ gar mkhan mchog sna tshogs grub pa la sogs pa la brten nas dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog la sogs pa dang*/ rgyal po ngal bsos po'i zhi ba nor sgrub dang*/ drag byed kyi cho ga la sogs pa mdzad pa las/ rnam sras zhi ba'i sgrub thabs rgyud dang*/ rgya gzhung dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag len dang mthun par rgyud dang mi 'gal ba'i lag len rang dga'i dri mas ma gos pa 'di gsol ba 'debs pa dag gi ngor bri ba la/ chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bzod par mdzod la byin gyis rlobs shig rten gyi gang zag phyag na rdo rje'i bsnyen pa las su rung bar byas shing*/ 'di nyid kyi lung dang rjes gnang thob pas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ stod g.yogs gos sngon po bgo ba/ lung thang gi phreng ba bgrang ba/ rta sha mi za ba/ yug sa mos phyag tshang byas pa'i zas mi za ba/ re ba nag po'i gdan la mi 'dug pa/ snod kha chag tu zas mi za ba/ mi ro dang rta ro la mi 'ju ba ste dam tshig bdun dang ldan pas/ phyi'i rten rta sngon po'i gzugs sam/ dngos su bcang ba dang*/ nang rten cho ga dang mthun par byas pa'i bris sku dgram pa dang*/ gsang rten bshad pa ltar byas pa'i bai3 sngags dang bcas pa'i ga'u ste/ rten gsum tshang bar btsugs nas/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal dri bzang dang bcas pa'i ba byung gis byugs shing*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas te bsang ngo*// de'i steng du me tog tshom bu dgu bkod la/ bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje'i mngon rtogs bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas nas/

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis phyogs kun tu bsang gtor bya'o// de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ hūm̐ las dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed la rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bsang gtor 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas bsang gtor dbul/ de bzhin du bsang gtor dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gi rjes su/ mchod yon dang*/ ar+ghaṃ/ zhabs bsil dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ zhal bsil dang*/ añtsa ma naṃ/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ mar me dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ rol mo dang*/ shab+da/ de rnams bcug la mchod do// de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ste/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan// gser ri'i lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing*// sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa// 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang*// bka' 'bangs bran slas rang lus nyer bdog can// ma chags mi zhum zab cing rgya che'i phyir// dgongs chen bsgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod// rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang*// don med don log cung zad don phyir ni// ha cang 'dod chen bskyed dang chog mi shes// bsam sbyor nongs pa gang bgyis mthol lo bshags// lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang phongs pa las// myur skyob 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten 'das// kun sgrol kun la phan dang bde ster ba// phrin las rgyun mi chad la rjes yi rangs// sna tshogs ya nga 'jigs dang mgon med dang*// sdig sdug brel phongs brgyas gzir skal ngan rnams// dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od// nyi zla rgyal mtshan ne'u le rnam rol bskul// khyed sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gying*// sgeg dul brtan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis// mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes bzung phyir// bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs// de ltar 'gro skyob khyed la 'gro ster slad// lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bkur na// bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzod rtag tu yang*// shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnyel mi gtong shog

/ces de dag gi don dran bzhin pas brjod de bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyi bo mgrin pa snying gar phog pas thams cad 'od du zhu nas mthar stong pa nyid du bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs te/ sbyor ba tshogs bsag pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus na/ khang pa brtsegs pa dgu yod pa'i dbus ma'i pho brang sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i rtse mo nor bu rin po che'i tog gi spras pa/ logs rnams su drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyar zhing*/ mda' yab dang pu shu dang ldan pa/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i ka ba nyis stong lnga rgya lnga brgyas phyogs re nas brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang pa brtsegs pa bco lngas spras pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po rin po che'i ljon shing me tog dang ldan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba mo brgyad spel mar gnas pa'i phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor bar gyur/ de ni rten bskyed pa'o// de'i dbus ma'i pho brang gi nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng bai3 ser po las rgyal mtshan bais mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus te bai la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/

g.yon na rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ seng ge nyal ba kha de nyid la lta ba'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal nas rin po che'i char 'bebs shing skye rgu phongs pa las sgrol ba/ dbu la rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon na nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing*/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam pa ni gtso bo bskyed pa'o// de nas shar gyi khang brtsegs kyi nang du pad+ma'i steng du rmugs 'dzin ser po phyag g.yas na rin po che bsnams pa/ de bzhin du/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu bsnams pa/ byang du ku be ra nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gyi gri bsnams pa/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung thogs pa/ nub byang du lngas rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs bsnams pa/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil pa gri dang phub bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can du gyur/ 'khor sa bar pa na gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs/ 'khor sa tha ma na lha ma srin sde brgyad/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gzugs can/ mi sdug cing brjid la rngams pa/ phyag g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bsnams pa/ g.yon thams cad gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ sku mdog mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa/ nam mkha' la sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin gyur/ spros pa la dga' na/ 'khor sa tha ma'i nang rim gyi shar du/ ring po/ mig bzang*/gang po/ ser skya ste bzhi/ lhor seng ge/ nye ba'i seng ge/ dung can/ dga' bo dang bzhi/ nub tu seng ge/ seng ge'i ral pa/

bla ma/ ser skya dang bzhi/ byang du 'dzin pa/ 'dzin dga'/ brtson skyong*/ khyab 'jug ste bzhi/ byang shar na lnga spyod/ shar lho na tshigs lnga ser po/ lho nub na ri mnyam/ nub byang na ser can te/ de rnams nor bu'i rigs so// shar na sa pa/ lho na shin tu sa pa/ nub na nag po/ byang na nye nag dang bzhi ni glang po che'i rigs so// byang shar na nyi ma/ shar lho na zla ba/ lho nub na me/ nub byang na rlung ste bzhi ni ba glang gi rigs so// sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad po thams cad mdog dmar nag cung zad khros pa'o// phyag g.yas na ral gri dang g.yon thams cad phub 'dzin pa'o// de'i phyi rim gyi shar du dbang po/ zla ba/ chu lha/ skye dgu'i bdag po/ gdos pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dbang ldan/ tsan+dan/ 'dod pa'i gtso bo ste brgyad dang*/ lhor mgrin ngan/ mgul ngos/ bā ḍi/ nor bu/ nor bu spyod/ sgra rab/ nye lnga po/ ri mnyam ste brgyad/ nub na gser can/ gang po/ seng ldang*/ g.yon phyogs lha/ ba glang skyong*/ 'brog gnas/ mi'i rgyal po/ rgyal ba'i khyu mchog ste brgyad/ byang na tshigs lnga ser po/ bzhin bzang*/ ring po/ dri za sna tshogs sde/ 'bras bu gsum pa/ mgul pa gsum pa/ lcags mdung ring po/ lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te brgyad ni stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis te mdog ljang nag gi go cha dang bcas pa/ mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ sa ga'i rigs dmag dpon gyi tshul du bsam pa ni 'khor bskyed pa ste dam tshig sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa'o// de nas spos kyi man ngag las byung ba'i ril bu bsreg med na 'bras phye dang spos dkar gyi dud pa btang*/ rnga dang dung la sogs pa'i rol mo mang po bya/ yid kyis rang phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de'i sna las khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po mdog dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa la thim par bsam/

lus kyi rgyal po 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya'am/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca' ba'am/ yang na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas ngag tu/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// thams cad nyon mongs 'dam byings pas// mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing*// gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod// thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs mdzod la// 'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// sems can kun la sman slad du// byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams// sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai3 swā hā/ oṃ bai3 shra ma ṇa ye ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ bai3 ring po brjid dang bcas pa mig 'dzum sum cu so gnyis kyi tshad brjod pas/ rgyal po'i thugs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bzhi bzhi bsam zhing*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sprel bar gyur pa ni ye shes pa spyan drang ba ste/ byon pa'i rtags snying 'dar ba dang*/ mgo sbrid pa dang*/ skyi bungs byed pa dang*/ grogs la 'babs pa dang*/ mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// de nas rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar bsam mo// oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes brjod de dbang bskur ro// de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam mo// de sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab pa rnams sngar ltar byas la/ sngar gyi tshig dang sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul lo// de nas/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*// gter chen bum pa pad+ma bzang*// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal bai'u// mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ bā+ai3 shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa kun la sbyar la/

aṣ+ṭa maṅga la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che// dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang*// cang shes rta dang theg chen glang*// phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i// dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bdag gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs phyir// rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas// 'khor dang bcas pas bzhes su gsol// sap+ta rat+na pū dza la sogs rin chen sna bdun dang*/ yid 'ong gzugs mdzes rnam pa dang*// rnar snyan rol mo'i rnam pa dang*// yid 'dzin dri dang phun sum tshogs// ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas dang*// 'jam mnyen 'khril chags na bza' dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs// rab 'byams khams na gang yod pa// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza la sogs pa 'dod yon lngas mchod par bya'o// bsdus pa la dga' na/ oṃ bai3 shra ma ṇa ye puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes pas me tog dang*/ dhū pe bdug spos dang*/ ā lo ke mar me dang*/ gan+dhes dri/ nai wi d+yas zhal zas dbul/ mchod pa spros pa la dga' na/ yan lag bdun pa'ang bya la/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na// bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni// ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che// sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod// btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*// khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad// nor ster ba ye klu chen brgyad// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang*// 'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing*// 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// gzhan don lhun gyis grub mdzad gsol// zhes pas bstod do// rgyal po'i thugs ka'i pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje/ de'i steng du bai gser gyi mdog can/

de'i mtha' mar snying po dang gzungs kyis bskor bar gsal gdab/ 'khor gyi thugs kar yab zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon/ rang rang gi ming gi yi ge dang po thig les brgyan pa la rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar bsam zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las dang*/ sngags kyang gsal btab ste/ lce rdo rje'i sbu gur bsams la/ sngags bzlas pas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'od kyi rtse mo las mchod pa'i tshogs spros te/ rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te 'jig rten gyi khams kyis mthu stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ dpal dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bye brag ci yod pa thams cad bsdus te/ bdag gi thugs kar thim par bsam zhing bzla'o// gzungs ni/ tad+yā tha/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha me sā dha ya/ tad+yā tha/ su ta ne/ su ra se/ su ma ti/ su bu ṣe/ hi li mi li swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ 'khor gyi snying po ni/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la ye swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pradzñā na ye swā hā/ oṃ gu h+ya s+tha na ye swā hā/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swā hā/ zhes pa'o// gtso bo'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcur bshad kyang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba las rtsod dus su bzhi 'gyur bshad pas bzhi bcu bya'o// de ltar bsnyen pa thems pa dang*/

sgrub pa bya ste zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga la maṇ+ḍal tsan+dan dkar po'i chus byugs te/ me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ der rgyal po 'khor bcas bsams la/ thun drug tu rgyal po la dmigs te sngags bzlas shing*/ a ga ru 'ba' zhig bsreg go /de ltar zla ba gcig tu bsgrubs na/ dpag tshad brgya ni tshun chad du// gnod sbyin rnams kyis srung bar byed// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad// kha na ma tho med pa yi// zas dang skom du bcas pa yi// nor 'bru dbyig dang gser stsol bgyid// rin po che yi gter sogs kyis// bsod nams tshad med 'grub par 'gyur// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub// ces sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba dang*/ gar mkhan mchog nas/ 'bum phrag gcig gis gnas khang g.yo// zhes pa dang*/ bcus ni mngon par shes pa thob// ces pa'i bar phan yon rnams 'byung ngo*// de ltar bsnyen sgrub thems nas las sbyor ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// de ltar bsnyen sgrub kyi dus su bzlas sgom gyis skyo na mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ste/ bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol lo// thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma phyag len ltar bshams la/ rta rkyang gi sha dang chang spangs la/ gzhan sha gtsang ma dang*/ dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar kham̐ las lha'i zhal zas dri ro phun sum tshogs par bsam/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du bsams shing*/ ngag tu lan gsum brjod pas yi ge gsum zhu nas nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur/

ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo ka na khaṃ sarba ar+tha sā dha naṃ gsum gyi gang la gang dgos su gyur par bsam/ swā hā/ zhes pas sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags lan gsum dang*/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa nam mkha' mdzod lan gsum gyis rgya cher spel lo// de nas thun gsham yin na mgron gsar du bskyed mi dgos te de nyid la dbul lo// gzhan du sa gzhi bsang ba dang sbyang ba byas nas/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa nas bzlas pa'i par du sngar bzhin byas la/ de nas yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ gtor ma dbul ba phyag len du snang yang*/ yan lag bdun pa mchod pa dang bstod pa'i bar du byas na legs par mthong ngo*// dbul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha ye swā hā/ i daṃ gyi gong du sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa bcug kyang nyes pa med do// 'khor rnams la'ang rang rang gi sngags kyi swā hā'i gong du i daṃ man chad btags la dbul/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa nā ga sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa zhes pa la i daṃ man chad btags la/ klu brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po bye ba'i tshogs la dbul/ yang na a kā ros dbul lo// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ rin chen pho brang dam pa na// mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na// bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni// ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che// sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs// g.yas pa rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin// g.yon pa gter gyi ne'u le bsnams// sku ni gser gyi 'od las mdzes// zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs// thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad// sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang 'khrungs// rnam thos sras su mtshan yang grags// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol// yon tan rdzogs la=

/gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// sde bo che la= /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed// stobs po che la= /bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan// dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dzam+bha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na// rin chen bsnams la phyag= /gang ba bzang po sku mdog gser// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng= /g.yon pa ne'u le= /bum pa bsnams la= /nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar// rdzu 'phrul rta= /g.yon pa ne'u le= /rin chen bsnams la= /ku be ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu 'phrul rta= /g.yon pa ne'u le= /ral gri bsnams la= /yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser// rdzu 'phrul= /g.yon= /gser gri bsnams la= /'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la// rdzu 'phrul= /g.yon= /mdung dmar= /lngas rtsen sku mdog ser skya la// rdzu 'phrul= /g.yon pa= /khang brtsegs= /bi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar// rdzu 'phrul= /g.yon= /gri phub= /gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs te// g.yon pa thams cad ne'u le la// g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed// stobs po che la= /mgon po 'khor bcas thams cad kyis// khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdus// khyod ni nor bdag chen po ste// nor bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang*// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// bu sdug bzhin du bskyang bar mdzod// bdag la gnod par sems pa ni// log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams// de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang*// gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i// gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis// bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa// myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/

yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang zhing bzod par gsol/ de nas ngag tu/ bai3 ring po gcig mig tsum sum cu so gnyis kyi tshad du brjod/ yid kyis pad 'dab kyi bai rnams gshegs par bsam zhing*/ snying ga'i 'od kyi lcags kyu bkrol bar bsams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// byang phyogs gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la ye shes pa byang phyogs su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu ba'am mi dmigs par bsam mo// rjes spyod lam thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga gzugs brnyan la brten te dbang du bsdu ba ni yi ge gud na yod pas der lta'o// yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar// mi mthun phyogs 'joms dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// lha mi'i mgon gyur mgon po gnas srung gi /sgrub thabs 'di yi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang*// spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang*// 'gro bzang snying po rin chen rdo rje dang*// kha che dgon pa zangs dkar lo tsā dang*// g.yor po jo ston bsod nams rin chen dang*// 'jed phu ba dang lha rje rdo bzang dang*// byams pa lo tsā bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// bsod nams seng ge seng ge'i mtshan can no// yang na/ phyag na rdo rje kā ma rū pa dang*// kar+ṇa pa dang 'gro bzang rin rdor dang*// bram ze sadz+dza na dang gzi brjid lha// 'phags pa shes rab zhu ston sa skya pa// grags pa seng ge rgya ston grub pa po// grub mchog rdo rje dpal dang rin po che// bla ma seng ge'i zhabs las legs brgyud pa'i// rin chen mang sprul rgyal po'i sgrub thabs 'di// blo mchog don gnyer blo gros rab rgyas pa// blo gros seng ges bskul phyir blo gros can// blo gros rab sbyangs blo gros mchog gyur pa'i// blo gros dri med bu ston kha ches sbyar// de yi dge ba dgos 'dod kun 'byung bas// rnam sras mnyes nas dgos 'dod re skong zhing*// 'gro ba kun la dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i// kun mkhyen dgos 'dod 'byung ba thob par shog

/rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung pa zhes bya ba sde snod 'dzin pa rin chen grub kyis khro phu dga' ldan gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'di sa steng du nyi zla ltar dar bar gyur cig/ // mchan/ 'di 'i nang rnam sras khang bzang dang phyag gnyis 'khor lo sogs pa'i ri mo mang tsam mchis pa bri ma thub/ ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
